authorization: User explicitly requested end-to-end Batch 01 production and approved additions; no pilot edits authorized or proposed.
content_decision: Approve the 36 reviewed qualitative L1/L2 cards, with disclosed editorial inferences and current-client visual follow-up. No cooldown or scaling cards.
counterplay_policy: Qualitative teaching implications of cited mechanics (sidestep projectiles, leave damaging areas, break tethers, respect shields and takedown buffs); not independently measured matchup or optimal-build claims.
build_focus_policy: Broad learning orientation from champion roles and damage/defense mechanics, not a claim about an optimal current-patch item build.

champ:caitlyn:overview:L1.counterplay: Avoid armed traps and sidestep her shots. An allied champion can intercept her ultimate shot.

champ:caitlyn:p:recognize:L2.answer: Caitlyn's basic attacks periodically fire an empowered Headshot for bonus physical damage. Trapped or netted enemies can also be hit by a special, longer-range Headshot.

champ:caitlyn:q:recognize:L2.answer: Caitlyn fires a piercing rifle shot that deals physical damage. It deals less damage after the first target, except against enemies revealed by her traps.
champ:caitlyn:q:recognize:L2.counterplay: Sidestep the shot and avoid stepping on traps that empower her follow-up.

champ:caitlyn:w:recognize:L2.answer: Caitlyn places a trap that arms after a short delay. An enemy champion who steps on it is rooted and revealed, enabling a powerful long-range Headshot.

champ:caitlyn:e:recognize:L2.answer: Caitlyn fires a net that deals magic damage and slows the first enemy hit. The recoil pushes her backward.

champ:caitlyn:r:recognize:L2.answer: Caitlyn targets an enemy champion from long range, channels, then fires a powerful shot that deals physical damage. Another enemy champion can intercept the bullet.

champ:ashe:overview:L1.counterplay: Sidestep her arrow and avoid a long chase while her attacks keep slowing you.

champ:ashe:p:recognize:L2.answer: Ashe's basic attacks slow their targets. Critical strikes strengthen the slow instead of adding normal critical bonus damage.

champ:ashe:e:recognize:L2.answer: Ashe sends a scouting hawk across the map, granting vision along its path and around its destination.
champ:ashe:e:recognize:L2.counterplay: Assume your route may have been spotted when the hawk passes over it.

champ:ashe:r:recognize:L2.answer: Ashe fires a global ice arrow. The first enemy champion hit takes magic damage and is stunned, for longer at greater travel distance. Nearby enemies are slowed.

champ:jinx:p:recognize:L2.answer: Jinx gains a burst of movement speed and attack speed when an enemy champion, epic monster, turret, or inhibitor is taken down shortly after she damages it.

champ:jinx:w:recognize:L2.answer: Jinx fires a long straight-line shot after a windup, dealing physical damage, slowing, and revealing the first enemy hit.

champ:jinx:e:recognize:L2.answer: Jinx throws a line of traps that arm after a brief delay. They root enemy champions who step on them and explode for magic damage.

champ:jinx:r:recognize:L2.answer: Jinx launches a global rocket that explodes on the first enemy champion hit, dealing physical damage in an area. Damage increases with travel distance and each victim's missing health.

champ:leona:q:recognize:L2.answer: Leona empowers her next basic attack to deal bonus magic damage and briefly stun its target.

champ:leona:w:recognize:L2.answer: Leona gains damage reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. After a delay, she deals magic damage around herself; hitting an enemy extends the defensive effect.

champ:leona:e:recognize:L2.answer: Leona sends her sword through enemies in a line, dealing magic damage. She briefly roots and dashes to the last enemy champion hit.

champ:leona:r:recognize:L2.answer: Leona calls down an area blast that deals magic damage. Enemies in the center are stunned; those near the edge are slowed.

champ:lux:overview:L1.answer: Lux is a long-range mage who can root enemies, slow an area, shield allies, and fire a powerful long-range laser. She deals most of her damage from a safe distance.

champ:lux:q:recognize:L2.answer: Lux fires a light projectile that deals magic damage and roots up to two enemies in a line.

champ:lux:r:recognize:L2.answer: After a brief windup, Lux fires a long-range laser that deals magic damage to enemies in its path. It also triggers and refreshes her passive mark.

champ:morgana:overview:L1.answer: Morgana is a mage support with a long-lasting root and a shield that absorbs magic damage and blocks crowd control while it holds. She damages enemies in a pool and can stun nearby champions who remain connected to her ultimate.

champ:morgana:p:recognize:L2.answer: Morgana heals when her abilities damage enemy champions, large minions, and medium or larger monsters.

champ:morgana:q:recognize:L2.answer: Morgana fires a projectile that deals magic damage and roots the first enemy it hits for a long time.

champ:morgana:e:recognize:L2.answer: Morgana shields herself or an ally, absorbing magic damage and blocking crowd control while the shield holds.

champ:morgana:r:recognize:L2.answer: Morgana tethers nearby enemy champions, dealing magic damage and slowing them while she gains movement speed. Enemies still tethered after a delay take damage again and are stunned.

source_conflicts.issue: Riot describes increased damage against Frost-affected targets; archived Wiki revision describes bonus attack damage from critical-strike chance independently of that condition.
source_conflicts.resolution: Omit the disputed bonus-damage condition; retain the mutually supported slow and critical-slow behavior. No damage formula or unsupported condition exported.

source_conflicts.issue: Riot and Wiki give different Sunlight durations.
source_conflicts.resolution: No duration is present in the qualitative Batch 01 card. Exact duration remains out of scope and must be independently verified before any L3/timer card.

Caitlyn.description: The demonstration shows her rifle attack sequence and an empowered Headshot.
Caitlyn.observation: Official P clip inspected as a sequence, not inferred from the icon. Specific ready-state weapon glow and enemy-perspective readability are not confirmed.
Caitlyn.manual_follow_up: Check Headshot readiness indicator and trap/net targeting cues in the current client, at normal card size and with relevant skins.

Ashe.description: Watch the frosted target and its movement after Ashe's attacks.
Ashe.observation: Official P frames show a frosted target following basic attacks; helps associate slow behavior with the passive.
Ashe.manual_follow_up: Check slow readability from the opponent's perspective and on different skins.

Jinx.description: After the takedown, watch Jinx's sudden burst of running speed.
Jinx.observation: Official P clip shows a takedown followed by Jinx's accelerated movement.
Jinx.manual_follow_up: Check the current-client Get Excited! effect and visibility during crowded fights.

Leona.observation: Official P clip includes other spell effects and allied follow-up. A distinct Sunlight target mark is not isolated confidently enough for an approved supplementary cue.
Leona.manual_follow_up: Review Sunlight target mark before/after an ally consumes it; retain champion-labeled passive icon for this release.

Lux.description: Look for the glowing mark after a damaging spell and its consumption by an attack.
Lux.observation: Official P frames show a target mark after a spell and the follow-up attack.
Lux.manual_follow_up: Check current-client mark appearance, expiry and skin-specific effects.

Morgana.observation: Official P clip mainly shows offensive spell effects, with no clearly readable health-bar evidence of Soul Siphon healing. No unique healing VFX is asserted.
Morgana.manual_follow_up: Review healing feedback with health bars visible in the current client; retain champion-labeled passive icon for this release.

visual_review.reviewer: Codex (contact-sheet inspection, not a live-client test)
visual_review.method: Four duration-relative samples from each full original WebM; all 30 source clips inspected in six labeled contact sheets. Original frame sequences remain available for human review.
visual_review.active_decision: All 24 active clips depict the named spell consistently enough for qualitative recognition. No fallback needed.
limitations: Contact-sheet review is not exhaustive playback
Riot CDN clips do not establish current-patch VFX accuracy
No desktop/mobile Anki GUI playback or enemy-perspective skin test performed
